```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
shift = read.csv("Bucknell_ShiftMed_Data_File.csv", header = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
popfocus = c("Philadelphia-Wilmington-Atlantic City PA-NJ-DE-MD CMSA", "Washington-Baltimore DC-MD-VA-WV CMSA", "Pittsburgh PA MSA", "St. Louis MO-IL MSA", "New York-Northern New Jersey-Long Island NY-NJ-CT-PA")
typefocus = c("CNA","LPN","RN","GNA","STNA")
smallshift = shift[shift$nurse_type %in% typefocus, ]
shiftfocus = smallshift[smallshift$nurse_msa %in% popfocus, ]
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(shift)) / dim(shift)[1] * 100
```
```{r}
ggplot(shift, aes(x = worker_status)) + geom_bar()

```
```{r}
count(shift, worker_status)
```

```{r}
ggplot(shift, aes(x = claimed_shift_2026, fill = claimed_shift_2026)) + geom_bar(na.rm = TRUE) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("red3", "green"))
```

```{r}
prop.table(table(shift$claimed_shift_2026))
```
```{r}
ggplot(shift, aes(x = shift$nurse_type)) + geom_bar()
```

```{r}
table(shift$nurse_type)
```
```{r}
ggplot(shift, aes(x = total_shifts_claimed_prior_to_2025, y = total_shifts_worked_prior_to_2025, color = worker_status)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "green") +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)
```
```{r}
shift$first = as.Date(shift$install_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
shift$last = as.Date(shift$first_shift_claimed_on_platform, format = "%m/%d/%Y") #flipped to available next
shift$time_diff = as.numeric(shift$last - shift$first)

shift$first2 = as.Date(shift$flipped_to_available, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
shift$last2 = as.Date(shift$first_shift_claimed_on_platform, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
shift$time_diff2 = as.numeric(shift$last2 - shift$first2)

#shift$first3 = as.Date(shift$intall_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
#shift$last3 = as.Date(shift$first_shift_claimed_on_platform, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
shift$time_diff3 = as.numeric(shift$first2 - shift$first)
```

```{r}
ggplot(shift, aes(x = time_diff3)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 50) + ggplot(shift, aes(x = time_diff)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 50)
```


```{r}
ggplot(shift, aes(x = time_diff2)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 50)
```

```{r}
ggplot(shift, aes(x = shift$time_diff)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 50)
```
```{r}
ggplot(shift, aes(y = shift$avg_distance_between_hcp_and_facility_worked_shifts, x = shift$total_shifts_claimed)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5)
```
```{r}
ggplot(shift, aes(x = shift$shifts_worked)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 25)
```

```{r}
table(shift$shifts_worked)
```
almost 1/3 never worked a shift... over 1/3 have only worked 1- 5 shifts... the other 1/3 have worked 6+ shifts

```{r}
table(shift$total_shifts_claimed)
```

more than 2/5 claimed 0 - 5 shifts. ~3/5 claimed 6+ shifts. yet only 1/3 worked 6+ shifts...

```{r}
barplot(bigtype)
```
```{r}
shift$wshiftratio = shift$guaranteed_shifts_worked / shift$shifts_worked
shift$cancelratio = (shift$shifts_call_out + shift$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shift$shifts_unscheduled) / shift$fac_cancelled_shift #total shifts cancelled / total shifts facs cancelled
```

```{r}
ggplot(shift, aes(x = wshiftratio)) + geom_histogram(na.rm = TRUE, binwidth = 0.025)
```
```{r}
ggplot(shift, aes(x = cancelratio)) + geom_histogram(na.rm = TRUE) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 25))
```
```{r}
sum(shift$cancelratio <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(shift$wshiftratio >= 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)

```
9674 people had more fac cancelled shifts than shifts cancelled of their own accord
1452 people had half of their total shifts be guaranteed shifts

```{r}
popfocus = c("Philadelphia-Wilmington-Atlantic City PA-NJ-DE-MD CMSA", "Washington-Baltimore DC-MD-VA-WV CMSA", "Pittsburgh PA MSA", "St. Louis MO-IL MSA", "New York-Northern New Jersey-Long Island NY-NJ-CT-PA")
typefocus = c("CNA","LPN","RN","GNA","STNA")
smallshift = shift[shift$nurse_type %in% typefocus, ]
```

```{r}
ggplot(shiftfocus, aes(x = total_shifts_claimed_prior_to_2025, y = total_shifts_worked_prior_to_2025, color = worker_status)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
```

```{r}
ggplot(shiftfocus, aes(x = avg_distance_between_hcp_and_facility_claimed_shifts)) + geom_histogram(bins = 15) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 500))  + ggplot(shift, aes(x = avg_distance_between_hcp_and_facility_claimed_shifts)) + geom_histogram(bins = 15) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 500)) 
```

```{r}
fivenum(shiftfocus$avg_distance_between_hcp_and_facility_claimed_shifts)
fivenum(shift$avg_distance_between_hcp_and_facility_claimed_shifts)
```
on the more focused group nurses are a little bit closer

```{r}
ggplot(shiftfocus3, aes(y = avg_distance_between_hcp_and_facility_worked_shifts, x = shifts_worked, color = nurse_type)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5)
```
```{r}

num_cols <- shiftfocus %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  names()

shiftfocus3 <- shiftfocus %>%
  filter(
    if_all(
      all_of(num_cols),
      ~ . >= quantile(., 0.01, na.rm = TRUE) - 
           1.5 * IQR(., na.rm = TRUE) &
        . <= quantile(., 0.99, na.rm = TRUE) + 
           1.5 * IQR(., na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
#should we remove outliers?

```
